resources.string: The key file that protects your data is missing. Without it the encrypted data cannot be read.
The key file that protects your data is damaged.
The secure hardware of this device no longer has the key that protects your data. This can happen after some system updates or a security reset. If you saved a recovery code, you can use it now.
The secure hardware of this device did not respond. This is usually temporary.
The key file could not be read. Check that the device has free space and try again.
Your existing data could not be moved to encrypted storage. It is still intact. Check that the device has free space and try again.
Enter the 28-character code you saved when you set up recovery.
That is not a valid recovery code. It has 28 letters and digits.
This code does not unlock your data.
No recovery code was set up for this data.
Your data was unlocked but the new key could not be saved. Try again.
Your current encrypted data will be set aside and the app will start empty. The old files stay on this device and are not deleted, but this version of the app cannot open them again.
This device has no screen lock
The app lock needs a PIN, pattern, password or biometrics on the device. Without one, anyone holding the phone can open the app. Set a screen lock in the system settings to restore the protection.
App lock, recovery code and encrypted storage
Ask for your fingerprint, face or screen lock when opening the app
Set a screen lock on this device to use the app lock
Set a screen lock on this device first.
A recovery code is set up
If the secure hardware of this device ever loses the key that protects your data, the recovery code is the only way to open it again.
Chats, characters, providers, API keys, images and avatars are stored encrypted on this device. The app lock adds a check every time the app is opened. Neither hides that the app is installed.
The current code will stop working and a new one will be shown.
Without a recovery code, your data cannot be recovered if the secure hardware of this device loses its key.
Write it down and keep it somewhere safe, away from this phone. It is shown only once. Anyone with this code and a copy of the app\'s files could read your data.
The recovery code could not be updated. Try again.
Hide content from screenshots and recents
Blocks screenshots and screen recording, and shows a blank preview in recent apps. With the app lock on, Android 13 and later already hide the preview.
Saved. This provider uses unencrypted HTTP: anyone on the same network can read your chats and API key.
Needed to change your security settings
